description: Stop: visual tactile safety paving line is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). A tactile paving line enables blind and visually-impaired people to move around independently in public spaces. The area between the outer edges of the tactile-visual safety paving line (guide line) constitutes the safe area in which these passengers can stay without danger. Coverage: Switzerland. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Infrastruktur, Bahnhof, Barrierefrei. The portal shows 2026-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
